body:
Hello Avicus I was wondering if any team leaders out there wanted to merge into the pvp team. Now the pvp team is epic we do scrims but we will only start scrims when we get to 20 people. If you want to know what merging is, it is where your whole team joins the pvp team {my team}. This team is a good opportunity to get in the tournaments coming up soon because we will scrim and I will watch the best pvpers. So if you are good at pvp and you want to join the pvp team just give me a shout.

We wouldn't mind any apps. If So please put:

Pros:

Cons:

Position:

PlayStation 4 IGN: {I Only want this because I have 1 and if you ever wanted we could speak}

And What Weapon Your Best With:


Thank You For Reading My Post And Hopefully Some of you want to join...

P.S: If You Wanna Join the pvp team and you don't have a team or your in one please just fill out the app and I will hopefully reply and accept you in :D

Good Luck <3
